title: Paper v2 live approval lifecycle is missing for future MiniQMT live promotion
description: Paper v2 and qmt_strategy_ledger have no enforceable live approval lifecycle for any future MiniQMT live promotion. Paper-enabled or paper-passed StrategyPackage status must not imply live eligibility; live approval must require immutable alpha-core identity, platform runtime release/profile/policy evidence, minimum Paper/MiniQMT SIM validation evidence, broker compatibility verification, human approval, risk note, and rollback plan.
required_verification: branch-file guardrail scan over git diff origin/main...HEAD
branch-file module ownership scan over git diff origin/main...HEAD
closure_requirements: Explicit live approval lifecycle exists before MiniQMT live is enabled.
Live approval records reference immutable package alpha core hash plus runtime release/profile/policy hashes.
Live route or live-like MiniQMT promotion is blocked without simulation validation evidence and human approval.
Paper-enabled, paper-running, or paper-passed status alone cannot grant live eligibility.
Approval, rejection, retirement, and rollback are auditable with approver, approval timestamp, risk note, and rollback plan.
